text: The Lowi brand is operated by Vodafone España: Lowi's own legal page states that Lowi and Lowi.es are registered trademarks of Grupo Vodafone and carries the Vodafone España (Avenida de América 115, 28042 Madrid) imprint. Corroborating source: Lowi legal page imprint (operator details) (https://www.lowi.es/legal/): "Vodafone España 2025. Avenida de América 115, 28042, Madrid"
short: Lowi is a registered trademark operated by Vodafone España.
